PrintAxisFaq1.description: Find quick, straightforward answers to frequent inquiries about our printing techniques, file specifications, production timelines, and custom delivery options.

faqList.question: What digital file formats do you accept for custom printing?
faqList.answer: We accept high-resolution vector PDF, AI, PSD, and EPS files. For best print quality, ensure raster graphics are at least 300 DPI at 100% final scale with CMYK color mode and 1/8 inch (3mm) bleed margins.

faqList.question: What is the typical turnaround time for orders?
faqList.answer: Standard digital print orders take 2 to 4 business days. Large-format offset printing, specialized foil stamping, and custom packaging boxes typically require 5 to 7 business days. Rush express same-day/next-day options are also available.

faqList.question: Can I review a hardcopy proof before full production begins?
faqList.answer: Yes! We provide complimentary digital PDF proofs for all jobs. For high-volume offset or packaging runs, physical press proofs and sample mockups can be shipped for your final physical sign-off.

faqList.question: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqList.answer: Thanks to our versatile digital printing equipment, we support short runs starting as low as 25 to 50 units for business stationery, apparel, and booklets. For custom packaging and corrugated shipping boxes, MOQs start from 100 units.

faqList.question: Do you provide eco-friendly and recycled paper stocks?
faqList.answer: Absolutely! We offer an extensive selection of FSC-certified recycled cardstocks, Kraft paper, and biodegradable plant-based soy inks to help your brand achieve sustainable, premium-grade branding.

faqList.question: Do you ship nationwide or handle international logistics?
faqList.answer: Yes, we ship across the country via trusted courier partners with tracking on all consignments. We also support scheduled split deliveries to multiple corporate branch offices upon request.
